messages.A locked AO3 work needs your cookie unde: A locked AO3 work needs your cookie under Settings, or drop the work's EPUB.
messages.A metered voice charges by the character: A metered voice charges by the character. Voices you connect yourself are not metered and do not touch this number.
messages.A subscription buys the platform: this s: A subscription buys the platform: this server, the reader app, your storage, and updates. It does not include a voice.
messages.Always keep it near the middle of the sc: Always keep it near the middle of the screen
messages.Author: Author
messages.Buy the platform only if you already hav: Buy the platform only if you already have a voice provider, or you are about to add one. If you have neither, stay on the free plan and connect a voice first.
messages.Drop an EPUB or paste a story link. Fire: Drop an EPUB or paste a story link. Fireside reads it, breaks it into chapters, and voices each one.
messages.Each source asks for what it needs (AO3: Each source asks for what it needs (AO3 asks for a cookie). These live on the server, never in this browser.
messages.Every device signed in to this server. Y: Every device signed in to this server. You can boot any of them.
messages.Everywhere this account is signed in. Lo: Everywhere this account is signed in. Log out a device you do not recognise.
messages.Fireside reads a book with a voice you c: Fireside reads a book with a voice you control. Three steps.
messages.Follow along: only when the sentence lea: Follow along: only when the sentence leaves the screen
messages.Label: Label
messages.Lift the storage or character check for: Lift the storage or character check for one account. Usage is still counted and shown; this only stops the refusal.
messages.No plan includes a voice provider. That: No plan includes a voice provider. That part is always yours to plug in.
Nothing here yet. Add a book to start.
messages.Numbers written with commas (50,000) are: Numbers written with commas (50,000) are read as words (fifty thousand) automatically. A plain 1999 or Chapter 12 is left as the author wrote it.
Pick a book from the Library first.
messages.Remove this book from my library: Remove this book from my library
messages.Saved to your account, so it follows you: Saved to your account, so it follows you to the phone.
messages.Scope: all books, one author, or one boo: Scope: all books, one author, or one book. A writer's own money glyphs usually belong to the author; a single story's belong to the book. The same word in a narrower scope wins.
messages.Scroll the page to follow it: Scroll the page to follow it
messages.Set an account's tier without a payment: Set an account's tier without a payment (a comp for family or a tester). Allowance and usage follow the tier.
messages.Sign in or create an account: Sign in or create an account
messages.Sign in with Google, GitHub, Microsoft o: Sign in with Google, GitHub, Microsoft or SimpleLogin instead of a password. Link one here while you are signed in.
messages.The app's own words. Books stay in the l: The app's own words. Books stay in the language they were written in.
The password you sign in with.
messages.The queue is empty. Open a book and pres: The queue is empty. Open a book and press ＋ Queue to add it. When a book finishes, the next one plays.
messages.The reader is free to try. A plan buys t: The reader is free to try. A plan buys the platform, and the platform is only half the story.
messages.The voice a new conversion starts on, an: The voice a new conversion starts on, and the voice the sandbox opens on. A book already voiced keeps the voice it has until you convert it again.
messages.The voice is what actually reads to you,: The voice is what actually reads to you, and it comes from a speech provider you connect yourself (your own Azure Speech key, or a server a friend shares with you). Without a voice provider the platform has nothing to read with, so a subscription on its own is close to worthless.
messages.Title: Title
messages.Type a line, pick a voice, hear it. Noth: Type a line, pick a voice, hear it. Nothing is saved and nothing is metered.
messages.Voice servers and source logins live on: Voice servers and source logins live on this server. Keys never reach your browser.
messages.Whether a stranger can make their own ac: Whether a stranger can make their own account on the buy page. Closed, only you can make accounts.
messages.While a chapter plays, the page marks th: While a chapter plays, the page marks the sentence being read and can follow it down the page. Timing is estimated from how long the chapter takes to say, so a long pause or a scene break can put it a sentence off. It never changes the audio.
Words and symbols the voice says wrong. Left: exactly what appears in the text. Right: how it should sound, spelled out (Qui-Gon → Kwai-Gon, ʛ → galleon). Works when the symbol is glued to a number too: 50ʛ and ʛ50,000 both read right.
messages.Your password signs in with this name. L: Your password signs in with this name. Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
messages.Your tier sets how much you can keep. St: Your tier sets how much you can keep. Storage counts once per book you hold; delete a book and its bytes come back.
